job.title: Finance Manager
job.description:
About the Company
Quinn Allan is partnering with a well-established and growing not-for-profit organisation that delivers essential services across multiple locations and entities.
With a strong reputation within its sector, the organisation continues to invest in its people, systems and operational capabilities. As part of an ongoing finance transformation journey, the business is focused on strengthening processes, embracing technology and building a best-practice finance function.
The culture is collaborative, values-driven and improvement-focused, encouraging employees to contribute ideas, challenge existing ways of working and make a meaningful impact beyond the numbers.

Reporting to the Financial Controller, the Finance Manager will lead the financial accounting function and take ownership of month-end close, balance sheet integrity, statutory reporting and external audit processes across a multi-entity group.
Leading a team of Financial Accountants, you will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, compliance and integrity of the organisation's financial information while supporting key reporting, tax and governance obligations.
This opportunity is ideally suited to a Manager from a Big 4 or mid-tier audit firm seeking their first move into industry. The role offers the opportunity to leverage strong technical accounting expertise while gaining broader ownership across financial accounting, statutory reporting, team leadership, systems improvement and finance transformation initiatives.
Beyond traditional financial accounting, you will play an important role in driving automation, improving processes and enhancing the use of technology within the finance function. Working closely with stakeholders across Finance, Operations and Technology, you will help strengthen controls, improve efficiency and contribute to the continued development of the organisation's finance capabilities.

Duties
  • Lead the month-end close process across multiple entities and ensure reporting deadlines are achieved
  • Review and approve journals, accruals, provisions, prepayments and intercompany transactions
  • Manage group consolidations, eliminations and financial accounting activities
  • Maintain the integrity of the general ledger, chart of accounts and financial structures within the ERP system
  • Oversee fixed asset, lease accounting and depreciation calculations
  • Own the balance sheet reconciliation framework and ensure timely review and sign-off of key accounts
  • Investigate and resolve aged, unreconciled or unusual balance sheet items
  • Prepare annual statutory financial statements in accordance with Australian Accounting Standards
  • Coordinate external audit activities and manage relationships with auditors and advisers
  • Support tax compliance activities, including income tax, GST, BAS, payroll tax and FBT requirements
  • Contribute to budgeting, forecasting and cash flow reporting processes
  • Assist with lender, covenant and regulatory reporting requirements
  • Lead automation, systems improvement and finance transformation initiatives
  • Act as the key finance stakeholder for ERP enhancements, reporting improvements and workflow optimisation
  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation and AI tools to improve finance processes
  • Lead, mentor and develop Financial Accountants while promoting accountability and continuous improvement

About You
This opportunity is well suited to a professionally trained Senior Financial Accountant ready to step into management, or a Big 4/mid-tier audit professional seeking their first move into industry. We're looking for someone who is technically strong, ambitious and eager to make a meaningful contribution, while continuing to develop their leadership skills within a dynamic and evolving environment.

Experience auditing or advising not-for-profit, health, disability, aged care or community services organisations will be highly regarded, although not essential.

You will have:
  • CA or CPA qualification
  • Strong experience auditing or preparing statutory financial statements under Australian Accounting Standards
  • Exposure to complex group structures, consolidations and intercompany accounting
  • Experience leading audit engagements and managing senior stakeholder relationships
  • Demonstrated ability to review work, provide coaching and develop junior team members
  • Strong technical accounting capability and attention to detail
  • Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with large datasets
  • ERP systems experience, with NetSuite exposure highly regarded
  • An interest in automation, technology and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships with both finance and non-finance stakeholders
  • A proactive, collaborative approach and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively

How to Apply
Please click 'Apply' to submit your resume online, or contact Olivia Reiber on 0404 520 078 for a confidential discussion.

This isn’t a role where you’ll spend your days on reconciliations. You’ll be the technical lead across financial accounting, tax, compliance, and treasury. That means working through complex accounting questions, advising on how the standards apply in practice, and making sure the numbers stand up to audit. The organisation’s size and complexity mean there is plenty to get your teeth into. There’s also real scope to leave things better than you found them. The business wants stronger controls, tighter processes and better use of its systems, and you’ll have a hand in shaping how that happens.

What You’ll Be Doing
  • Working through complex accounting issues and advising on how Australian Accounting Standards apply in practice
  • Owning the integrity of the financial statements, general ledger and month-end and year-end close
  • Managing tax obligations and compliance reporting
  • Overseeing treasury, including liquidity, loan facilities, cash reserves and banking relationships
  • Leading the audit process from planning through to closing out findings
  • Reviewing and strengthening accounting policies, procedures and controls
  • Spotting where processes can be redesigned, automated or better supported by systems, and building the business case to make it happen
About You
  • CA or CPA qualified with a relevant tertiary qualification
  • You genuinely enjoy the technical side and are comfortable forming a view on the grey areas
  • Experience leading statutory reporting and audits in a large, complex organisation
  • Solid exposure to tax and treasury
  • An improvement mindset, with a track record of strengthening processes and controls
  • The ability to explain technical matters clearly to people outside finance
  • Experience in a large ERP environment will be highly regarded
If you like solving problems and want your work to make a real difference to how a large organisation manages its finances, this is a rewarding 12 months.

How to Apply

Click apply to submit your resume, or reach out to Matt at Quinn Allan for a confidential conversation about the role.

job.title: Procurement & Supply Chain Manager - Australia
job.description:
About the Company
Segafredo Bean Alliance Australia is a leading coffee roaster, manufacturer and distributor, backed by Massimo Zanetti Beverage Group, one of the world's largest vertically integrated coffee companies.
  
Combining global capability with local expertise, the business partners with many of Australia's leading café, retail and foodservice customers.

With significant growth ambitions and a business-wide transformation agenda underway, this is an outstanding opportunity to join a market leader and make a genuine impact on its future success.
 
About the Position
Reporting to the Managing Director, Oceania, the Procurement & Supply Chain Manager will be responsible for procurement, purchasing, inventory planning and supply chain activities across the Australian business.

This is a hands-on leadership role that combines strategic oversight with day-to-day execution. You will play an active role in managing supplier relationships, sourcing activities, purchasing, inventory planning and supply continuity while partnering closely with stakeholders across the business.

A key focus of the role will be the management of green coffee spend, the organisation's largest and most strategic procurement category, alongside a broader portfolio of enterprise spend categories.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and implement sourcing and category strategies across key spend areas
  • Lead supplier negotiations and manage supplier relationships locally and internationally
  • Oversee purchasing, inventory planning and inbound supply activities to ensure materials availability and support production requirements
  • Monitor commodity markets, pricing movements, freight trends and supply risks
  • Ensure continuity of supply and strong alignment across procurement, operations, sales and finance
  • Provide commercial input into budgeting, forecasting and business planning activities
  • Partner with global procurement stakeholders to align sourcing strategies and leverage group capability
  • Support ongoing business improvement and transformation initiatives 
About You
You are a commercially minded procurement and supply chain professional who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with operational execution. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, you build strong relationships, influence stakeholders and deliver results.

You will bring:
  • Experience leading procurement and supply chain activities within a hands-on operational environment
  • Experience within FMCG, food and beverage manufacturing, agribusiness or another commodity-driven environment
  • Strong supplier management, negotiation and commercial capability
  • Experience managing international suppliers and global supply chains
  • Strong analytical, financial and stakeholder management skills
  • A proactive approach to problem solving and continuous improvement
Experience within the coffee industry or exposure to green coffee procurement will be highly regarded. However, prospective applicants from FMCG, food manufacturing, agribusiness and other commodity-driven environments are encouraged to apply.
 
This is an opportunity to join a highly regarded business at the heart of Australia's coffee industry, where your contribution will be visible, valued and impactful. Local and international travel will be required.
  
How to Apply
Please click 'Apply' to submit your resume online or call Tony Megally on 0422 141 941 for a confidential discussion.
  
Quinn Allan has been exclusively retained to manage this appointment on behalf of Segafredo Bean Alliance Australia. 

Australian working rights are essential. Sponsorship is not available.
